data.title: Calculating Circle Circumferences
data.description: Practice computing the circumference of various circles using the radius or diameter. Apply the formula C = 2πr or C = πd with π ≈ 3.14 to solve real-world measurement problems.

challenges.narration: A circular running track has the radius shown.
challenges.instruction: Find the circumference — the distance all the way around.

challenges.narration: A bicycle tire has the diameter shown.
challenges.instruction: Find the circumference — the distance all the way around.
challenges.hint: Circumference = π × d (or 2 × π × r). Use π ≈ 3.14.

challenges.narration: A trampoline has the diameter shown.
challenges.instruction: Find the circumference — the distance all the way around.
challenges.hint: Circumference = π × d (or 2 × π × r). Use π ≈ 3.14.

challenges.narration: A trampoline has the radius shown.
challenges.instruction: Find the circumference — the distance all the way around.
